Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(bytes=Path("pdf/fake_memo.pdf").read_bytes(), config={"output_format": "markdown"}, filename="fake_memo.pdf", kind="bytes")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
